scope: progressive conversation compression and collision retrieval

finding.failure: old compressed turns were losslessly duplicated as durable_memory kind=source_archive and resurrected in full during cross-session collision retrieval
finding.directive_conflict: the old conversation stream must progressively age to a 1-2 word trace while durable semantic facts/decisions/tasks survive separately

new_contract: old turns can age to compression generation 5 with at most 1-2 words
before destructive compression explicit FACT/DECISION/TASK/COMMITMENT/PREFERENCE/OPEN markers are idempotently extracted
the original source is represented after compression only by a non-reversible SHA-256/size receipt, not a hidden full transcript
legacy source_archive duplicates are removed when that session is compacted
cross-session collision retrieval never resurrects raw archived text; it returns the compressed trace plus bounded extracted semantic fragments
compression_receipt is provenance metadata and is excluded from ClayGraph semantic nodes

assertions: generation 5 trace contains at most 2 words
private non-semantic source token is absent after compression
recompression does not duplicate extracted fact memory

limitations: this receipt is a targeted deterministic falsifier/regression, not an exact-current-head full pytest receipt
general unmarked semantic extraction remains a separate open quality gate
OCI build and live Clerk/Claude/EntityOS E2E are not claimed
